body: +1, this is blocking me from validating `es6-shim` with `eslint`. I tried to fix it but it appears to be some sort of fundamental assumption throughout eslint, and I lack enough context.
I'll be sure this gets fixed in the next release.

body:
This was reopened due to a report by @ljharb on #1492, which is a similar bug in the comma-spacing rule. This is the stack trace accompanying the report:

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'range' of null
at EventEmitter.module.exports.api.getTokenBefore (…/eslint/lib/eslint.js:837:31)
    at RuleContext.(anonymous function) [as getTokenBefore] (…/eslint/lib/rule-context.js:69:33)
    at checkList (…/eslint/lib/rules/no-multi-spaces.js:141:36)
    at EventEmitter.ArrayExpression (…/eslint/lib/rules/no-multi-spaces.js:163:13)
    at EventEmitter.emit (events.js:117:20)
    at Controller.controller.traverse.enter (…/eslint/lib/eslint.js:634:25)
    at Controller.__execute (…/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:318:31)
    at Controller.traverse (…/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:394:28)
    at EventEmitter.module.exports.api.verify (…/eslint/lib/eslint.js:627:24)
    at processFile (…/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:131:27)
    at …/eslint/lib/cli-engine.js:226:30
```

Part of 58e8da9, which closed this issue, involved moving checks for arrays out of the `checkList` function into a new `checkArray` function. However, I see in the stack trace at the top of this issue and the one included here that `checkList` is still being called, which makes me think that that's not an updated version of ESLint. Also note that the first several lines of both traces are the same, which shouldn't be the case after 58e8da9 was merged.

@ljharb, can you run `eslint --version` and be sure that it reports 0.10.0, which was just released?

I cloned the repo and ran `npm link`. Both there, and when I `npm install -g eslint` and `eslint --version` is `0.10.0`, I get this:

``` shell
…/eslint/lib/token-store.js:87
        return tokens[starts[node.range[0]] - (skip || 0) - 1];
                                 ^
TypeError: Cannot read property 'range' of null
    at EventEmitter.api.getTokenBefore (…/eslint/lib/token-store.js:87:34)
    at RuleContext.(anonymous function) [as getTokenBefore] (…/eslint/lib/rule-context.js:70:33)
    at …/eslint/lib/rules/comma-spacing.js:75:43
    at Array.forEach (native)
    at validateCommaSpacing (…/eslint/lib/rules/comma-spacing.js:74:19)
    at EventEmitter.ArrayExpression (…/eslint/lib/rules/comma-spacing.js:132:13)
    at EventEmitter.emit (events.js:117:20)
    at Controller.controller.traverse.enter (…/eslint/lib/eslint.js:635:25)
    at Controller.__execute (…/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:318:31)
    at Controller.traverse (…/eslint/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:394:28)
    at EventEmitter.module.exports.api.verify (…/eslint/lib/eslint.js:628:24)
```

Thanks, so looking at the newer stack trace, the error is in comma-spacing, which is what #1492 is about. Are you still seeing any issues elsewhere with no-multi-spaces, or did 58e8da9 successfully fix this?
Personally I'm not, no, I commented about the error message, not the specific rule mentioned in the stack trace.
Okay re-closing and focusing in on #1492.
